messages.subject: Issue: running simInit() when using CRAN version of reproducible
messages.subject_clean: Issue: running simInit() when using CRAN version of reproducible
messages.body_plain:
Dear SpaDES community,

There is an unresolved issue with the CRAN version of reproducible that is causing an error when running simInit() - if using modules that require spatial manipulation tools (e.g. raster functions).
However, this issue is resolved on the  sideEffectAsPath branch of the GitHub reproducible repository. So re-installing reproducible from this branch seems to allow running simInit() and spades() smoothly:

devtools::install_github("PredictiveEcology/reproducible@sideEffectAsPath")

Cheers and happy SpaDESing :)
Ceres

messages.subject: RStudio can't find slotNames() when running spades()
messages.subject_clean: RStudio can't find slotNames() when running spades()
messages.body_plain:
Dear SpaDES users,

There is currently a minor bug with RStudio when running spades(), which outputs an error despite the model running fine (apparently).
This seems to be due to the fact that each module changes the searchPaths() order so that functions can be searched on the packages relevant for that module first. At some point, RStudio is incapable of finding slotNames() outputting an error.

This does not happen when spades() runs directly on a stand-alone R console - so that should "fix it" for now ;)

Cheers and happySpaDESing :)
Ceres
